description: Source file implementing the AAudioFlowGraph class for audio processing, including configuration, processing, volume, and balance control.

classes.name: AAudioFlowGraph
classes.description: Class managing audio flow graph configuration, processing, and volume/balance control.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the audio flow graph with source and sink formats, channel counts, and optional mono blending and volume ramping.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes audio data from source to destination for a given number of frames.

methods.name: setTargetVolume
methods.description: Sets the target volume level for the audio stream.

methods.name: setAudioBalance
methods.description: Adjusts stereo balance between left and right channels.

methods.name: setRampLengthInFrames
methods.description: Sets the length of volume ramps in frames for smooth volume transitions.
